finding_key: docs/design/sheets/datasource.md::datasource design doc not updated for the new per-connection session settings and custom pg type-parser policy
evidence: The supplied docs/design/sheets/datasource.md §"Query Execution" enumerates the connection/execution contract (query wrapping, 30s statement timeout, 10s connection timeout, 10k row cap, response shape) and contains no mention of the two new session statements added in datasource.service.ts (`SET TimeZone = 'UTC'`, `SET DateStyle = 'ISO, MDY'`) or of the new `types: { getTypeParser: datasourceTypeParser }` policy that returns DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ as raw Postgres text — so the factual assertion of doc drift is correct, and the UTC normalization is genuinely user-visible. One sub-point is weaker: limitation #9 ("all values displayed as strings") and the "Column type awareness" roadmap item remain accurate, since the change deliberately keeps everything string-valued (toCell in readonly.ts) rather than introducing type mapping. Impact is documentation-only with no functional or correctness consequence, and the doc is already stale elsewhere (e.g. the Access Control section still describes `ds.authorID === userId` while the controller now checks workspace membership).
